product_metadata.title: Kings Brand Furniture – Darien 3 Step Wood Step Stool for Adults or Kids, Dog Stairs, Black
features: Kings Brand Furniture – Darien 3 Step Wood Step Stool for Adults or Kids, Dog Stairs, Black
Even if you're all done growing, you can give yourself an extra few inches with high step stool.
Crafted from manufactured wood, this piece features three steps to help you hop onto a high bed or reach upper corners of a kitchen cabinet.
While its understated design and neutral finish allow it to blend in with an existing arrangement.
Dimensions: 16"W x 19"D x 14"H. Finish: Black. Materials: Wood.
